description: Wahanie, the spirit of hesitation at a crossroads, a tall pale grey ghostly figure whose body splits into two halves leaning two ways like the letter Y, two faces looking in two directions with worried glowing eyes, two arms pointing two different ways, an abstract eerie creature, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, floating, full body, the creature alone, no signpost, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture
